claims: Design-Bid-Build is a construction project delivery method where design, bidding, and construction occur in sequential phases.
DBB is the ticker for the Invesco DB Base Metals Fund.
The Invesco DB Base Metals Fund is an ETF tracking aluminum, zinc, and copper futures.
In Design-Bid-Build, design is fully completed before bidding and construction begins.
In Design-Bid-Build, the owner holds separate contracts with the designer and the contractor.
The Invesco DB Base Metals Fund invests in liquid base metal futures (aluminum, zinc, copper).
The Invesco DB Base Metals Fund tracks the DBIQ Optimum Yield Industrial Metals Index.
DBB refers to a Double Block and Bleed valve.
A Double Block and Bleed valve is a type of valve, or a combination of valves.
A Double Block and Bleed valve is used to isolate piping systems by trapping a space between two closed surfaces and venting it to ensure no leakage.
DBB refers to Dixie Boys Baseball.
Dixie Boys Baseball is a youth baseball organization for ages 15-18.
